description: Search the Raise Lens directory of sustainability funders and investors (foundations, climate VCs, corporate investors, development finance institutions, government funders) by topic, funder type, funding type and geography. Returns up to 20 funders ranked by relevance to the query, then by how many open opportunities each has on Raise Lens. Each has name, type, funding types, sectors, geographic focus, cheque size, next deadline, how to apply, open opportunity count and its raiselens.com page.

funding_type.description: grant, equity, debt, guarantee or any. Matches what the funder states, or what its type implies when it states nothing.

geography.description: Country or region: ISO-2 ("KE"), English name ("Kenya") or a region ("East Africa"). Matches funders based there or naming it in their focus.

open_now.description: true: only funders open to applications or with open opportunities listed.

query.description: What the funder backs, e.g. "green hydrogen", "mangrove restoration", or a funder name.

name: search_funders

plans_url.description: Raise Lens page that lists what each option includes; null when every record is full.

access.description: Level of detail in this record: summary or full.

application_note.description: How to approach or apply, as the funder describes it.

cheque_size.description: Usual and largest ticket, in words (USD).

geographic_focus.description: Countries and regions the funder states it covers.

open_opportunity_count.description: Open grants and calls from this funder listed on Raise Lens.

open_to_applications.description: yes, no or unknown, as the funder states it.

recent_grants.description: Recent grants or investments to organisations.

title: Search funders and investors
